description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: E0a (.45). Blocks: E4 (.23).**

Two coupled gaps surfaced when scoping E4 (.23):

1. `Extension.API.bind_core/2` is only called by `EventBusDemo` today. Production extensions (`TriggerCompact`, `CustomCompaction`) get the raise-on-call stubs from `api.ex:206`, so `api.compact.([])` from `trigger_compact.ex:30` will crash on first invocation.

2. `Dispatcher.cancel_on_result/3` returns `:ok | {:cancel, term()}`. Upstream `:session_before_compact` handlers can also *supply* a pre-built compaction (`{compaction: {...}}`) — there's no channel for that today. `CustomCompaction` at `custom_compaction.ex:24-48` smuggles via `{:cancel, %{compaction: ...}}`, which the existing test file (`compaction_extensions_test.exs:2-22`) calls out as a known gap.

This ticket fixes both so E4 (.23) can implement compact orchestration on a clean substrate.

## Scope

### Part 1 — API binding via Coder.Session

- New `OctoPi.Coder.Session.actions/1` (or `bind_extensions/1`) that takes a `Coder.Session` pid and returns the `actions` map for `API.bind_core`. Each action is a thin closure: `fn args -> GenServer.call(session_pid, {:action_name, args}) end`.
- For this ticket, only wire the actions Coder.Session can answer today: `get_branch`, `get_leaf_entry_id`, `get_entries`, `append_entry`. The compact / send_message / set_model / etc. closures route to their corresponding GenServer calls but the call handlers can `{:reply, {:error, :not_implemented}, state}` — they get bodies in their own tickets.
- Update `Extension.Loader` (or the call site that finalizes extensions) so production extensions receive a bound API after `module.init/1`. Keep the existing test-only path (raw stubs) for unit tests that don't want a real session.

### Part 2 — Dispatcher override channel

- Rename `Dispatcher.cancel_on_result/3` → `Dispatcher.halt_on_result/3`. Return type: `:ok | {:cancel, term()} | {:override, term()}`.
- Halt rule: stop on first non-`:ok`/non-`nil` handler return. Map `{cancel: ...}`-shaped returns to `{:cancel, _}` and `{override: ...}`-shaped returns to `{:override, _}`. Pick a canonical Elixir return shape — recommendation: handlers return `:ok | nil | {:cancel, term()} | {:override, term()}` directly.
- Update `Extension.Event` pattern label to match the rename.
- Update `compaction_extensions_test.exs` to use the new return shape; remove the docstring caveat at lines 2-22.
- Update `CustomCompaction` to return `{:override, %Compaction.Result{}}` instead of the smuggle-through-cancel hack at `custom_compaction.ex:24-48`. Note: `Compaction.Result` is the new struct from .20.

## Tests

- API binding: a Coder.Session-bound API answers `get_branch.()` / `get_leaf_entry_id.()` / etc. with values from the GenServer; raise-on-stub behavior preserved when `bind_core` is skipped.
- Dispatcher rename: all existing `cancel_on_result` tests pass under the new name; a new test asserts `{:override, value}` halts and surfaces the value; `:ok` after `:override` still wins-first; cancel still beats override (handler order matters).
- CustomCompaction round-trip: handler returns `{:override, %Result{}}` and the dispatcher surfaces it.

## Out of scope

- The `api.compact/1` body (.23).
- Wiring TUI.Interactive to start `Coder.Session` (do this in .23 or a separate boot ticket — pick one in .23's plan).
title: E0b. Production Extension.API binding + dispatcher override channel
